name: CWB Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: CWB Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacturing, processing, sale, and after-sales service of automotive parts and accessories in China and internationally. The company offers automotive electronics, including three electrical systems, active safety, vehicle power supply, signal connection, solder-free terminals, and data acquisition and transmission. It also provides consumer electronics, such as wire to board, wire to wire, board to board, FPC/FFC, and jumper connectors, as well as chain terminals and splices and other products.
